                              mtime, last_scanned_at, match_method, match_confidence,
                              status, is_present, last_seen_at)

                   '2024-01-01 00:00:00', 'phase_b', 1.0, 'owned', 1,
                   '2024-01-01 00:00:00')
           RETURNING id AS "id!: i64"
